intro.text: The background prior to Family Office of America Inc., on December 17, 2024, the Company’s name was changed from “Qualis Innovations, Inc.” to “Family Office of America, Inc.” with the State of Nevada, and that name change (and accompanying stock ticker change from “QLIS” to “FOFA”) was processed by FINRA on or about December 23, 2024. Family Office of America, Inc. (the “Company” or “Family Office”), formerly known as Qualis Innovations, Inc., Hoopsoft Development Corp., Yellowcake Mining Inc., Sky Digital Stores Corp., and Sky Digital Holdings Corp., was incorporated in the state of Nevada on March 23, 2006.
